voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Gabi-gabi, sa Malacañang, may isang ilaw na kusang bumubukas.
lines.beat_before: hook: the palace at night, every window dark; one switches on

lines.text: Mula pa noong panahon ng Kastila, dito na nakaupo ang kapangyarihan.
lines.beat_before: the palace by the river at night, capiz windows

lines.text: At sa loob ng maraming henerasyon, iisa ang kuwento ng mga nagtatrabaho rito.
lines.beat_before: a guard's round: a long hall with wooden floors and portraits, a flashlight

lines.text: Isang lampara sa mesa, nakabukas sa hatinggabi, sa kuwartong walang pumasok.
lines.beat_before: a strip of light under a door; inside, a desk lamp lit, the chair turned to the window

lines.text: Mga yabag sa itaas, pabalik-balik, parang isang lalaking hindi mapakali.
lines.beat_before: footsteps pacing above; the guard looks up at the ceiling

lines.text: Usok ng sigarilyo, sa kuwartong walang tao.
lines.beat_before: the next room: smoke curling in the light, from no one
a child's laugh down the hall; a ball rolls out of a doorway

lines.text: At minsan, sabi ng isang empleyado, isang paring naglalakad sa pasilyo, walang ulo.
lines.beat_before: silence; the guard turns; at the far end of the hall, a cassock with nothing above the collar walks away (stinger in silence)

lines.text: Hindi ito ipinapaliwanag ng mga guwardiya. Pinapatay na lang nila ang ilaw.
lines.beat_before: the guard switches off the lamp

lines.text: Bukas na naman ito kinabukasan ng gabi.
lines.beat_before: outside: the window dark; then it lights again
